title: Rulebook process (mechanics/processes/<slug>.json)
description: A continuous change applied every sub-step while `when` holds (regeneration, cooldown, a projectile in flight). `dt` is the sub-step length (one turn in a turn-based game) (spec/feature/rulebook.md §3).

of.description: Whose variables change: world, stage, self or entity (each living entity in turn).

rate.description: New value of each variable after one sub-step (an expression of the current values and dt).
